title: 음료, 정류장, 종로: ㅁ·ㅇ 뒤의 ㄹ은 [ㄴ]
objective: You can spot a final ㅁ or ㅇ before ㄹ and say the ㄹ as [ㄴ].
summary: Learn why ㄹ sounds like [ㄴ] after a final ㅁ or ㅇ, as in 음료 [음뇨].

task.title: Find and say [ㄴ]
task.line: Look for ㅁ or ㅇ before ㄹ, then choose, write, or check the sound.

words.exampleMeaning: What would you like to drink?
I'm meeting a friend in Jongno.
There are many kinds of ramyeon.

letters.sound: After final ㅁ, read ㄹ as [ㄴ]: 음료 [음뇨]
After final ㅇ, read ㄹ as [ㄴ]: 종로 [종노]

exercises: Choose the correct pronunciation: ① 동료 ([동료] / [동뇨]) ② 공룡 ([공룡] / [공뇽]) ③ 음력 ([음녁] / [음력])
Write how each word sounds in [ ]: ① 강릉 ② 승리 ③ 심리
Does the ㄹ change to [ㄴ]? Write Yes or No: ① 서류 ② 능력 ③ 노래
Write how the word in brackets sounds: ① 제 동생은 (명랑)해요. ② (장래)에 뭐 하고 싶어요?
A friend reads these words aloud. Is the friend right? Write O or X: ① 염려 → [염녀] ② 대통령 → [대통령] ③ 영리 → [영니]
answers: ① No (ㄹ comes after a vowel: [서류]) ② Yes ([능녁]) ③ No (ㄹ comes after a vowel: [노래])
① O ② X (correct: [대통녕]) ③ O
